title: Extraordinary Xanthan British Turkey Mince Chocolate Yorkshire Pudding
description: A snappy date-night British dish featuring earthy turkey mince, tempering chocolate, and low-glycemic-friendly Yorkshire pudding.
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together coconut flour, xanthan gum, salt, and cinnamon.
In a separate bowl, mix together turkey mince, egg whites, granulated Swerve, and melted butter.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until just combined.
Pour the mixture into a greased 9x13-inch baking dish.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the edges are set and the center is slightly gooey.
While the turkey mixture is baking, melt the chocolate chips in a double boiler or in the microwave in 30-second increments, stirring between each interval.
Remove the turkey mixture from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Pour the tempered chocolate over the turkey mixture and smooth the top.
Return the dish to the oven and bake for an additional 5-7 minutes or until the chocolate is set and the edges are golden brown.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
